a.lede: General Motors has agreed to pay $220 million to settle claims that it illegally sold driver and location information to data brokers, as reported earlier by Reuters. The agreement, which resolves a complaint from a coalition of 36 US attorneys general, requires GM to limit the driving data it collects and obtain "express consent" from […]
a.title: GM to pay $220 million to resolve claims it sold driving habits data

b.lede: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.
b.title: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
